title: Beyond Gaussian Calibration: Local Inference in Decentralized SGD
abstract: arXiv:2611.28370v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decentralized SGD minimizes a common objective by local gradient steps and neighbor averaging. Its statistical theory mostly concerns network averages, yet clients act on their own iterates, and one-sided decisions such as alarms use one tail of the local error. We show that a client's constant-step endpoint can have nearly nominal Gaussian coverage while both tails are badly miscalibrated. An exact noise-filter representation explains why: a quantity computable from the graph and stepsize decides whether the endpoint is asymptotically Gaussian, and when the number of clients outgrows the inverse stepsize on networks with summable return probabilities, such as lazy tori of dimension at least three and expanders, a few recent noise terms at nearby clients keep a fixed share of local variance. On these tori the limit is a non-Gaussian local field plus an independent Gaussian consensus term, and no reference distribution built from finite

translated_title: 超越高斯校准：去中心化SGD中的局部推断
translated_abstract: 去中心化随机梯度下降通过局部梯度步与邻居平均来最小化一个共同目标。其统计理论大多关注网络平均值，然而客户端实际上是基于自身的迭代值采取行动的，且诸如告警之类的单侧决策仅使用局部误差的单侧尾部。我们证明：客户端在恒定步长下的端点虽然整体覆盖率可接近标称高斯水平，但其两个尾部却严重失准。一个精确的噪声滤波表示解释了其中原因：一个可由图结构与步长计算出的量决定了端点是否渐近服从高斯分布；当客户端数量超过步长的倒数时，在具有可和返回概率的网络（例如维度至少为三的惰性环面以及扩张图）上，邻近客户端的少数近期噪声项会保留局部方差的一个固定份额。在这些环面上，极限分布是一个非高斯局部场加上一个独立的高斯共识项，并且没有任何基于有限……构建的参考分布（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示去中心化SGD中客户端局部端点虽整体高斯覆盖率接近标称但双尾严重失准，并给出一个可由图与步长计算的精确噪声滤波判据，证明在特定网络上极限分布是非高斯局部场与独立高斯共识项之和。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in decentralized SGD a client's local endpoint can achieve nearly nominal overall Gaussian coverage while both tails are badly miscalibrated, and derives an exact noise-filter criterion computable from the graph and stepsize, proving that on certain networks the limit is a non-Gaussian local field plus an independent Gaussian consensus term.
